info.name: Store API - Orders & Inventory
info.description: End-to-end checks for every endpoint and business rule. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or `npx newman run`). Seeded accounts come from the environment file.

exec: // Unique suffix per run so SKUs/emails never clash with earlier runs.
